## Forum Energy Technologies to Present at the 17th Annual Midwest IDEAS Investor Conference


August 25, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.f-e-t.com/node/15541/pdf)


HOUSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Aug. 25, 2026-- Forum Energy Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: FET) announced today that Neal Lux, President and Chief Executive Officer, will present at the 17th Annual Midwest IDEAS Investor Conference on Wednesday, August 26, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. Central Time.


The event is open access and interested parties can register through the following link:


[2026 Midwest IDEAS Conference](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.summitcast.com%2Fview%2FhikLhLKfYwig3p3KSoADwT%2Fguest_book%3Fsession_id%3DMTxyQSao5s3WLwuFiqXjfY&esheet=54593427&newsitemid=20260824139655&lan=en-US&anchor=2026+Midwest+IDEAS+Conference&index=1&md5=dc742cfc714ba5738d1006f11440fe27)


A link to the live webcast and the presentation slides will be available on FET’s website at[ir.f-e-t.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.f-e-t.com%2F&esheet=54593427&newsitemid=20260824139655&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.f-e-t.com&index=2&md5=88e5e8ff3ab78b88af88b9dddf85f957) prior to the event.


About IDEAS Investor Conferences


The mission of the IDEAS Conferences is to provide independent regional venues for quality companies to present their investment merits to an influential audience of investment professionals. The IDEAS Investor Conferences are held annually and are produced by Three Part Advisors, LLC. Additional information about the events can be located at[www.IDEASconferences.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.IDEASconferences.com&esheet=54593427&newsitemid=20260824139655&lan=en-US&anchor=www.IDEASconferences.com&index=3&md5=e05579724e86b02416bae4bc6e2ee281) .


*FET® is a global manufacturing company, serving the oil, natural gas, defense, and renewable energy industries. With headquarters located in Houston, Texas, FET provides value added solutions aimed at improving the safety, efficiency, and environmental impact of our customers' operations. For more information, please visit[www.f-e-t.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.f-e-t.com&esheet=54593427&newsitemid=20260824139655&lan=en-US&anchor=www.f-e-t.com&index=4&md5=a3291e0c37898671755bdad93ed9922a) .*
